Anya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re pricing/credits/quota questions. Customers keep asking about accidental credit exhaustion and how limits are applied. I'll list the concrete asks so we can assign owners: 1) Can promo credits be reissued? 2) Are default rate limits org or key scoped? 3) Can trials be configured to throttle instead of fully consuming credits? 4) What's the support flow for emergency extensions?

Leah: Short answers: 1) One-off reissues possible but not automatic. 2) Defaults are org-scoped; per-key caps are available. 3) Yes — we should offer a "managed trial" toggle that throttles. 4) Support can escalate to Finance for emergency one-time extensions. We'll publish a clear one-pager.

Martin: Finance input: any credit reissue must be logged and approved; automated mass reissues would be a billing risk. We can provide a template approval flow and keep an audit trail. For committed credits under contracts, unused amounts are handled per SOW.

Tom: Infra note: we already emit rate limit headers (`X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`). Adding `X-Quota-Mode: soft|hard` is straightforward. Implementation plan: soft mode returns 429 with `Retry-After` but includes `X-Quota-Decision: throttled`. We can also emit webhook events `quota.threshold` and `quota.actioned` for observability. Example response:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1200
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-Quota-Mode: soft
X-Quota-Decision: throttled
Retry-After: 30

Rhea: Support playbook idea: when a customer reports accidental burn we ask for org id, api key id, time window, and desired outcome (extension vs config change). Provide canned reply: "We can review for a one-time extension; to avoid future issues enable managed trials which throttle usage before credits deplete."

ops-bot: Quota config deployed to staging 2025-09-02T10:05Z: feature flag `managed_trials` enabled.

Anya: Action items: Product to draft the one-pager and console copy (Anya), Infra to add `X-Quota-Mode` + webhook (Tom), Finance to draft approval template (Martin), Support to add canned responses and checklist (Rhea). Please link PRs here. Target: next Wednesday.

Leah: Thanks — make the one-pager public-facing (Pricing FAQ) and internal playbook for CS. Keep messaging consistent: "promo credits expire, are non-transferable by default, and managed trials can throttle."

Anya: Will do. I'll drop the draft here when ready. Thanks everyone! :tada:
